memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "Then Isaac said to Jacob, 'Come near so I can touch you, my son, to know whether you really are my son Esau or not.' Jacob went close to his father Isaac, who touched him and said, 'The voice is the voice of Jacob, but the hands are the hands of Esau.' He did not recognize him, for his hands were hairy like those of his brother Esau; so he proceeded to bless him. 'Are you really my son Esau?' he asked. 'I am,' he replied. Then he said, 'My son, bring me some of your game to eat, so that I may give you my blessing.' Jacob brought it to him and he ate; and he brought some wine and he drank." - Gen 27:21-25 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Isaac senses that something is off. "The voice is the voice of Jacob," he says, "but the hands are the hands of Esau." His instincts are half-warning him. He even asks directly, "Are you really my son Esau?" And Jacob answers with another flat lie: "I am."

Here is a heartbreaking picture of how deception hardens. It would have been easier to stop at the first lie. But once we start down that road, we must keep lying to protect the last lie, and each falsehood comes a little more easily. Jacob looks his blind father in the face and deceives him again.

Notice too that Isaac had a moment of doubt but did not press it. Something felt wrong, yet he let it go because the disguise was convincing and, perhaps, because he wanted to believe it was Esau. Both the deceiver and the deceived play their part.

Deception often unravels slowly and painfully because people keep choosing the lie. The way out is always to stop and tell the truth, however costly. One honest word can break the whole chain. When you sense that first crack of conscience, do not silence it — heed it.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. When my conscience gives a warning, do I heed it or push through?
2. Have I ever kept lying just to protect an earlier lie?
3. Where do I need one honest word to break a chain of deception?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, help me to heed the warnings of my conscience and to choose truth even when it costs me. Break every chain of deception in my life. Amen.
